propositions: _lib_writes.py has hit the 800-line hard cap and cannot accept new public library write verbs without exceeding the enforced module-size limit
The sibling story adding two optional create_ticket arguments requires widening @overload signatures and docstrings, which cannot land until headroom is restored by splitting the module

Seven distinct concerns (genesis, identity/keys, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, signing) are commingled in _lib_writes.py, making it grow on two independent axes: new verbs append wrappers and existing verbs widen in place

The fix is to partition _lib_writes into three modules by concern: _lib_writes (genesis+status), _lib_mutations (leaf mutations+session logs+store maintenance), and _lib_identity (identity/keys+signing), each targeting the 200-500 LOC band

All 27 distinct public names must remain accessible as rebar.<name> and rebar._lib_writes.<name> after the split via re-export, leaving __init__.py, _lib_gates.py, and tests/ unchanged to minimize diff
